YOUNG ADULTS · 16–24

Preparation for Adult Life

The programme enables young adults to understand their internal programming meaning they begin to learn vital information about themselves, their triggers, their language, their behaviours.

Programme details ›JOIN PAL

Through the PGP, you will learn how to…

  1. 01

    Know yourself

    Understand your values and how they influence your choices.

  2. 02

    Build inner strength

    Build confidence, resilience and emotional intelligence.

  3. 03

    Connect with others

    Strengthen communication and relationships.

  4. 04

    Think with clarity

    Develop a reflective mindset for clearer decision-making.

  5. 05

    Respond rather than react

    Understand your triggers, and respond rather than react.

  6. 06

    Embrace change

    Navigate change, challenge and uncertainty with confidence.

  7. 07

    Put growth into practice

    Apply practical tools in both your personal and professional life.

THE SHARED FOUNDATION

Further build your CHARACTER.

C · Curiosity

Cultivate a desire to learn and explore new ideas. Embrace questions and seek knowledge about oneself and the world around us.

H · Humility

Recognise that growth involves acknowledging your limitations. Stay open to feedback and learn from others.

A · Authenticity

Be true to yourself. Embrace your values and have the courage to be YOU.

R · Resilience

Develop the ability to bounce back from setbacks. View challenges as opportunities for growth and learning.

A · Accountability

Take responsibility for your actions and decisions. Reflect on your choices and learn from them.

C · Courage

Have the bravery to step outside your comfort zone. Embrace new experiences, even when they feel daunting.

T · Tenacity

Persevere in the face of difficulties. Stay committed to your goals and keep moving forward.

E · Empathy

Foster understanding and compassion for others. Recognising their experiences can enrich your own growth journey.

R · Reflection

Regularly assess your progress and experiences. Take time to think about what you’ve learned and where you want to go next.
